headlines.title: Inside Russia’s industry of forced POW videos
headlines.description: Russia has coerced thousands of Ukrainian prisoners to denounce their leaders and country in propaganda videos. The consequences can follow them home.

headlines.title: Paramount reaches deal with California, other states over Warner merger
headlines.description: The California Attorney General’s Office announced a settlement agreement Monday resolving a 12-state legal challenge to Paramount Skydance’s $110 billion merger with Warner Bros.

headlines.title: Flights resume after air traffic equipment failure snarls traffic in Newark, Philadelphia
headlines.description: A major circuit blew at the Philadelphia facility that controls air traffic to Newark Liberty International, Teterboro and Philadelphia airports Monday — causing widespread delays and cancellations to thousands of flyers on the East Coast.

headlines.title: ‘Block the Merger’ push continues as Paramount settles with state AGs
headlines.description: About 20 opponents of the Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger took their fight to the New York Attorney General’s office on Monday.

headlines.title: Tech stocks power market surge as bond yields and oil prices tumble
headlines.description: Tech stocks surged Monday, with the Nasdaq 100 recording its single best day since early August as a wave of euphoria swept over the markets.

headlines.title: Poll: Most voters say Trump has hurt the economy as competitive midterm election looms
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s sinking ratings threaten to drag down Republicans in November’s midterm elections, as voters blame him for high prices and a shaky economy, according to a new NBC News poll.

headlines.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway
headlines.description: Warren Buffett announced he is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after 60 years at the firm. Investopedia editor-in-chief Caleb Silver breaks down how Buffett has impacted the investment world.

headlines.title: Why Networking is the Essential Career Tool
headlines.description: Networking can open doors and create opportunities, so LinkedIn editor-in-chief Dan Roth stops by TODAY with the keys to doing it effectively and making authentic connections. He shares tips on how to find your network, shares conversation starters when meeting someone new, explains how to make outreach personal and specific and more.

headlines.title: Trump Sounds Off on Fed’s Decision on Interest Rate
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in years amid soaring consumer prices and against the wishes of President Donald Trump. “The board is very hostile. They’re very political. They’re doing the wrong thing,” he said. It comes as the president traveled to battleground North Carolina in an effort to help Republicans maintain control of Congress. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: What Does the Interest Rate Hike Mean for American Consumers?
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 on Wednesday in a move aimed at slowing inflation. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY to break down how the 0.25% hike will impact credit cards, mortgages and the cost of food and gas.

headlines.title: American dream of owning a home out of reach for many as mortgage rates soar (again)
headlines.description: Interest rates on a 30-year fixed mortgage soared to 7.2%. Coupled with near record high prices, it’s putting homeownership out of reach for millions.

headlines.title: CNN, Politico and MS NOW plan to sue Trump admin over ban on White House coverage
headlines.description: NBC, ABC, CBS and Fox News also declined to step in and provide pool coverage of the president after CNN was banned from doing so on Monday.
